# Forward Tasks (`forward_tasks.md`) Standard

The Forward Tasks operating standard (SOP) and blank template have been centralized in the `dotfiles` repository and are loaded via the global skill path:

- **Live Skill Path**: `~/.gemini/config/skills/git-forward-tasks-tracker/SKILL.md`
- **Template Path**: `~/.gemini/config/skills/git-forward-tasks-tracker/resources/forward_tasks_template.md`
- **Sync Command**: Pull the latest version from your local `dotfiles` repository clone (`git pull origin main`).
